_id: GOLDEN rung for G5S1R1. Built on golden_baseline.json via _extends, so every sigma, bias and process-noise value is the sourced one (docs/golden_baseline_provenance.md) and a change to the golden propagates here automatically. The delta below is the formation size and the two-way time-transfer toggle, nothing else.
_delta: nReceivers 1 instead of the golden's 4. The golden is explicitly a four-phase-centre design; this rung is the single-antenna configuration and loses the four independent code-thermal samples per tower per epoch. twoWayTimeTransfer disabled (TW0), so the radial-clock degeneracy is left in place.
